zip_layout: GamePush hosting takes one archive with index.html at its root and re-serves it to every platform the game is distributed to, so the same build must run on all of them. Latin file names only.

metadata.orientation: declared per game in the panel
metadata.hosting: GamePush hosting; the panel creates a draft from the uploaded archive
metadata.distribution: one build is re-published to the platforms selected in the panel, so nothing in the artifact may name a single host
metadata.upload_config: Panel project settings: the save field the game reads must exist as a player field before the first upload, or writes are dropped without an error
metadata.upload_command: none; the archive is uploaded in the GamePush panel

sdk_policy.load_policy: The adapter injects the SDK with the project id and public token as query parameters and receives the instance through a global callback. Four mirrors carry the same file; the first that answers wins, so a blocked CDN is not a dead game.
sdk_policy.ads: showFullscreen for interstitial, showRewardedVideo for rewarded, showSticky/closeSticky for the banner, showPreloader before gameStart only; every format is gated on its is*Available flag
sdk_policy.storage: player fields on GamePush servers: set() then sync(); a field the panel does not declare is dropped silently
sdk_policy.leaderboards: the platform has a board, but this game keeps its own so one ranking spans every target
